Title: Daniel's Visions of Kingdoms
DateApprox: c. 553-536 BC (first year of Belshazzar to third year of Cyrus)
Events: Across the reigns of Belshazzar, Darius, and Cyrus, Daniel receives a series of visions - four beasts from the sea, a ram and a goat, seventy weeks, and a final revelation by the Tigris - tracing successive kingdoms and promising that the saints of the Most High will possess the kingdom forever.
